candidates.change_summary: Replace the assert check with a require that uses a different condition (>= instead of >), allowing zero-value deposits to be accepted differently.
Remove the overflow check by deleting the assert line, making deposit accept any msg.value and update balances without the guard.
Insert a require that forbids zero-value deposits, reverting when msg.value == 0 and thus changing observable balances for zero-value calls.

Change the addition order to perform balances[msg.sender] = msg.value + balances[msg.sender] (behaviorally identical in arithmetic but a single-statement edit that is semantically same; omitted because must change observable—so instead change to set to msg.value only), setting the balance to msg.value rather than incrementing it.
Replace the transfer-before-balance-decrement order with decrement-before-transfer, causing different behavior when transfer fails or reentrancy occurs.
Remove the transfer call so withdraw only updates the balance, changing external observable behavior by not sending ETH.
Replace transfer with a call that forwards all gas and returns success; revert on failure, altering behavior and gas semantics.
Change the require to allow withdrawing more than the balance (remove the check), enabling over-withdrawal attempts to proceed and potentially fail on transfer.
